title: Install a new package on Arch Linux
summary: Install a specific software package from the official repositories. This command also installs any required dependencies automatically.

steps.explain: Install the specified package. Replace <PACKAGE_NAME> with the name of the software you want to install.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the package to install

rollback.explain: Remove the package and its dependencies that were installed with it.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the package to remove
